item.text: {"decisions":[{"id":"native-install-failure","verdict":"pass","reason":"Correctly identifies fs-ext@2.1.1, its node-gyp install phase, the manifest parent dependency, and missing MSVC/Visual Studio as the cause."},{"id":"static-import-trap","verdict":"pass","reason":"Correctly explains that the top-level fs-ext import still loads at boot, so ignoring scripts alone only hides the build failure and does not make the module loadable."},{"id":"platform-lock-contract","verdict":"pass","reason":"Correctly distinguishes the Windows named-semaphore path from POSIX flock and preserves the semaphore while treating fs-ext as load-time-only on Windows."},{"id":"reproducible-local-patch","verdict":"partial","reason":"Provides the right local pnpm patch strategy and verification plan, but omits the required build-permission handling and proposes a throwing fallback rather than the compatible warning/no-op callback fallback."},{"id":"machine-and-upstream-boundaries","verdict":"pass","reason":"Respects the no-Visual-Studio constraint and explicitly keeps the dependency declaration and upstream repository unchanged."},{"id":"corridor-mapping","verdict":"fail","reason":"Names DSH-0.1.3-A1-S20 rather than the required full card ID DSH-0.1.3-A1-03."}],"caps":[{"id":"requires-visual-studio","triggered":false,"reason":"The plan explicitly rejects installing Visual Studio or Build Tools."},{"id":"ignore-scripts-only","triggered":false,"reason":"The report rejects --ignore-scripts as a standalone solution and includes an import-safe patch."},{"id":"upstream-edit-required","triggered":false,"reason":"The proposed fix uses the repository-managed pnpm patch mechanism rather than requiring upstream edits."},{"id":"lock-bypass","triggered":false,"reason":"The plan preserves the Windows named semaphore and POSIX native flock behavior."}]}
